decisions.reason: A same-message MODIFY already extends the prompt's scope to the Toy Factory mini game and all grades, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.
Expanding grade coverage does not change the curriculum-alignment rule or resolve the existing uncertainty about which topics belong in Grade 2.
The requirement already applies per level throughout the Toy Factory mini game; all-grade coverage does not alter the distinct-object rule.
The all-grade decision does not change the requirement to classify each level's visual representation or its supported representation types.
All-grade coverage does not modify the progression rule and does not resolve the outstanding number-of-levels question.
Using ChatGPT to automate content work does not necessarily resume or otherwise modify the separately deferred C# random-generator requirement.
The source changes overall grade coverage but does not change the sorting classification, number range, or supported arithmetic problem types.
